newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CBR gain 2 pct on renewed share interest.
newsitem.headline: CBR gain 2 pct on renewed share interest.

text.p: Shares in leading Belgian cement maker CBR, a unit of Germany's Heidelberger Zement, jumped 2.17 percent on Tuesday, with dealers putting it down to a rebound from recent profit-taking.
CBR lost over 10 percent of its stock price between March 12 and March 20 when investors panicked over indications that the U.S. Federal Reserve would raise interest rates.
By 1225 GMT CBR was up 1.87 percent, at 3,290 francs, slightly off its early high of 3,300 francs, with a modest 45 million Belgian francs worth of shares traded.
